title: Mind in Motion Older Adults Walking Over Uneven Terrain
description: This dataset comprises high-density, dual-layer electroencephalography (EEG), neck electromyography (EMG), inertial measurement unit (IMU) acceleration, and ground reaction force recordings collected from older adults walking over uneven terrain at varying speeds. Each participant completed multiple walking trials under different conditions as well as a seated rest trial, with digitized electrode locations provided. The dataset supports research into the neural and biomechanical mechanisms underlying balance and gait control during complex locomotion in aging populations.
methods_description: Participants performed two three-minute trials for each walking condition over uneven terrain at different speeds, along with a seated rest trial. High-density dual-layer EEG, neck EMG, IMU acceleration, and ground reaction force were recorded simultaneously, and digitized electrode locations were saved for each subject.
